scope.known_issue: Exact-model sources conflict: an independent 2023 review states 32 mm, an owner reports a 28 mm answer attributed to Basso, and a specialist retailer says the manufacturer maximum is unpublished and 32 mm is theoretical. No numeric maximum is assigned.

allowed_work: One Luna evidence-only worker may make one exact-model search for a manufacturer-owned Basso technical/product page covering the Venta Disc, then open at most one clearly official exact-model result once. This search is only to locate that primary source and must not open retail, marketplace, owner or community routes. Report the official domain/page identity, current access date, whether it is the same Venta Disc generation, and any explicit maximum tire-size/clearance wording plus units and conditions. No clicks, sign-in, purchase, alternate model, or further search/open. The primary writer may add a dated source record and update the exact candidate/attempt only if the primary page clearly resolves the model and numeric claim; otherwise preserve the conflict and record the result.
stop_conditions: Stop if the official page is unavailable, challenge-gated, for another Venta generation, or does not state an unambiguous exact-model maximum.
Do not infer maximum clearance from fitted tire width, frame photographs, retailer theory, a sibling model or an owner statement.
Do not average 28 mm and 32 mm or rewrite the existing source/search history.
done_criteria: The exact conflict is either resolved by a primary same-generation specification or remains explicitly conflicted with the candidate value unknown.
Fresh data:gaps and research:queue quantify the post-batch state.

Run validate, research:check, monotonic coverage acceptance/check and git diff --check; run the full npm run check gate once if source or catalog records change. No image report because no image record is in scope.
